关键词云图

宽度强于指数 港股科技偏弱 逆周期加力 地产价格确认 高利率分化 金融营销新规 固态电池规划 新股破发 停牌与延迟业绩
利好利空中性w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
地缘
伊朗停火僵局与中东出口恢复信号并存
地缘风险仍支撑能源溢价，但中东出口恢复迹象令Brent回落；油价与长债的组合仍是A/H成长估值的重要外部约束。
政策
国常会部署逆周期增量政策与稳地产措施
会议要求优化财政支出、用好地方政府债务结存限额，适时调整货币工具，增加科技创新和技改再贷款，并研究稳定房地产市场、促进就业增收政策。
政策
金融产品网络营销管理办法今日实施
新规自9月30日起厘清金融机构与第三方平台责任并禁止误导性营销，银行、券商、互联网平台及金融科技服务商进入合规整改窗口。
产业
新型电池“十五五”规划指向固态电池规模化
七部门规划提出到2030年全固态电池初步实现规模化应用；产业方向明确，但技术、良率、资本开支和量产节奏仍需公司级验证。
市场
A股宽度修复但节前成交降至阶段低位
9月29日AKShare盘中快照显示3434涨、1945跌、中位数+0.47%，但上证仅+0.02%；沪深成交约1.41万亿元，为2025年7月以来低位，节前追价需谨慎。
美股映射
长债高位压制指数，Meta与FICO走势极端分化
标普、道指分别跌约0.17%和0.24%，QQQ代理微涨0.18%；10年美债收益率升至5.293%。Meta涨3.26%，FICO因按揭评分定价政策冲击跌26.66%。
美股映射
最新板块排行未覆盖9月29日交易
GitHub Actions排行抓取于9月29日10:17 CST，只覆盖9月28日美股时段；本期不沿用旧行业Top/Bottom与概念Top5，当前排行按0行降级。
公司
万科A受稳地产预期推动涨停收盘
万科A 9月29日收4.08元、涨9.97%，成交放大；政策与价格反馈形成共振，但节前缩量环境和公司基本面压力仍构成反证。
港股
罗博特科H股首日破发
H股以436港元发行，首日收414.40港元、低约4.95%；A股同日收529.00元、跌0.25%，一级市场热度未转化为明确二级市场正反馈。
港股
多想云继续停牌并延迟业绩披露
HKEX公告类别显示公司涉及延迟业绩、业务更新及继续停牌；在披露与复牌条件未完成前，不把潜在业务进展包装成多头。
公司
中远海特拟长期光租6艘重吊船
子公司拟光租6艘6万吨级多用途重吊船，租期约20年，交付后年租金约1.34亿元；运力扩张与长期固定成本、需求波动并存。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数与宏观
指数小幅收低，长端收益率升至多年高位
道指、标普500和纳指分别跌0.26%、0.17%和0.08%；10年与30年美债收益率升至5.293%和5.6206%，高利率继续限制估值扩张。
个股与映射
Meta、CarMax走强，FICO出现重大负反馈
Meta涨3.26%、CarMax涨4.74%，FICO跌26.66%、NVDA跌0.76%；A/H映射应聚焦公司事件与监管敏感度，不把QQQ微涨外推为科技普涨。
排行可用性
行业与概念排行快照滞后一日
最新快照 attemptedAt=2026-09-29 10:17 CST，未覆盖9月29日美股完整交易；行业与概念均按0行降级，不使用旧榜单或个股行情替代。

盘前结论

事实：逆周期和稳地产政策获得万科A价格反馈，A股上涨家数和中位数改善；金融营销新规与新型电池规划提供合规和产业线索。

判断：节前最后交易日以低仓位、强验证为主；地产只观察已获量价确认的龙头，固态电池与金融科技等待公司级公告和相对强度。

不确定性：成交缩至阶段低位、港股科技跌1.55%、美债长端处于多年高位；罗博特科H股破发和多想云停牌均显示主题与价格/披露之间存在反证。

重点个股推荐

万科A
SZ.000002
条件关注

事实与状态：稳地产政策预期推动9月29日收4.08元、涨9.97%，成交约8.02亿股；属于已出现价格反馈的政策交易，不等于基本面风险消失。

确认条件：节前开盘后维持相对地产指数强势、成交承接未快速衰减，且没有新增债务或销售端重大不利。

风险与失效：低价股波动、行业销售与信用风险、节后政策兑现落差；若高开回落并弱于地产板块则取消观察。

罗博特科
SZ.300757 / HK.03757
回避追高

事实与状态：H股发行价436港元，首日收414.40港元、低4.95%；A股9月29日收529.00元、跌0.25%。硅光设备叙事未获得A/H同步正反馈。

重新评估条件：H股重新站上发行价且A股同步强于光通信/专用设备板块，并出现持续成交承接。

风险与失效：首日破发、估值与设备周期、扩产执行风险；当前负面价格反馈不得包装成多头。

多想云
HK.06696
回避

事实与状态：公司继续停牌，业绩披露仍延迟，无法取得可交易的最新价格；披露缺口和复牌不确定性高于业务叙事。

重新评估条件：完成逾期业绩、满足联交所复牌指引并恢复正常交易，且审计与内部控制问题有可核验结论。

风险与失效：长期停牌、审计与治理不确定性、潜在除牌风险；在复牌条件满足前维持回避。

板块轮动看板

地产链

稳地产政策与万科A涨停形成共振，但节前成交收缩，关注龙头承接而非扩散追涨。

固态电池

2030年规模化目标提供中期方向，短线需量产、良率和订单公告，不恢复旧式主题泛化。

金融科技

网络营销新规今日生效，合规服务需求上升，同时平台整改成本和业务限制并存。

港股科技与新股

恒生科技偏弱、罗博特科H股破发；高估值硬科技以价格反馈为优先反证。

逻辑链

逆周期政策 + 稳地产措施 → 万科A涨停确认短线交易 → 节前只跟踪龙头承接。
A股3434涨/1945跌 + 上证仅+0.02% + 成交低位 → 宽度强于指数但动能有限 → 控制追价。
QQQ微涨 + 美债10年5.293% + FICO暴跌 → 成长内部高度分化 → A/H科技按公司事件核验。
罗博特科H股破发 + 多想云停牌 → 上市与业务叙事不能替代价格和披露 → 两者均列回避。

风险雷达

节前流动性

沪深成交降至2025年7月以来低位，假期持仓与节后跳空风险提高。

长债与油价

10年美债收益率5.293%，地缘与能源价格仍可推高通胀和贴现率。

港股科技与新股

恒生科技跌1.55%，罗博特科首日破发，热门主题的估值承接并不稳定。

数据时点

AKShare fetchedAt=2026-09-29 13:45 CST，为前一交易日盘中快照；美股排行 attemptedAt=2026-09-29 10:17 CST，未覆盖9月29日交易，因此排行0行降级。

数据来源与时间点

中国政府网/新华社（9月28日国常会）、财联社与东方财富（9月30日起金融营销新规、9月29日市场与公司公告）、工信部等七部门新型电池规划、Reuters（9月29日中美股市、港股新股及美债）、HKEXnews（多想云停牌/延迟业绩）及CNINFO（罗博特科H股发行公告）。AKShare fetchedAt=2026-09-29 13:45 CST、status=ok、analysisReady=true；美股排行 attemptedAt=2026-09-29 10:17 CST，因滞后一日按0行降级。万科A、罗博特科价格均为9月29日收盘；多想云停牌无可交易报价。证据截止08:35 CST。

Keyword map

Breadth beats index Weak HK tech Policy support Property confirmation High-yield divergence Marketing compliance Solid-state roadmap IPO break Suspension risk
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes relevance, not return.
Major news
Geopolitics
Iran ceasefire deadlock meets signs of recovering Middle East exports
Geopolitical risk still supports an energy premium, while export recovery signals pushed Brent lower. Oil and long yields remain key external constraints on A/H growth valuations.
Policy
State Council outlines incremental counter-cyclical and property support
Measures include optimizing fiscal spending, using local-debt quota headroom, adjusting monetary tools, adding tech and equipment-upgrade relending, and studying property and employment support.
Policy
Online financial-product marketing rules take effect today
The Sep 30 rules clarify duties of financial firms and third-party platforms and ban misleading marketing, opening a compliance-upgrade window for banks, brokers, internet platforms and fintech vendors.
Industry
New-battery plan targets solid-state scale adoption
The seven-agency plan targets initial large-scale application of all-solid-state batteries by 2030. Direction is clear, but technology, yield, capex and ramp timing require company-level evidence.
Market
A-share breadth improved as pre-holiday turnover hit a phase low
The Sep 29 AK snapshot showed 3,434 advancers, 1,945 decliners and a +0.47% median, but Shanghai gained only 0.02%. Combined turnover near CNY1.41tn was the lowest since July 2025.
US mapping
High long yields capped indexes as Meta and FICO diverged sharply
SPY and DIA proxies fell 0.17% and 0.24% while QQQ edged up 0.18%; the US 10-year yield rose to 5.293%. Meta gained 3.26%, while FICO plunged 26.66% on mortgage-score pricing policy.
US mapping
Latest sector rankings do not cover the Sep 29 session
The GitHub Actions snapshot was fetched Sep 29 10:17 CST for the Sep 28 US session. Stale industry Top/Bottom and concept Top 5 rows are excluded; both groups are degraded to zero rows.
Company
Vanke A closed limit-up on property-support expectations
Vanke A closed Sep 29 at CNY4.08, up 9.97%, on heavy volume. Policy and price confirmation align, but pre-holiday liquidity and company fundamentals remain counter-evidence.
Hong Kong
RoboTechnik H shares broke below the offer price
The H shares were offered at HK$436 and closed their debut at HK$414.40, about 4.95% lower. The A shares closed at CNY529.00, down 0.25%, showing no synchronized positive feedback.
Hong Kong
Many Idea Cloud remains suspended with delayed results
HKEX categories flag delayed results, business updates and continued suspension. Business narratives cannot be treated as bullish until disclosure and resumption conditions are completed.
Company
COSCO Shipping Specialized plans long-term leases for six heavy-lift ships
A subsidiary plans 20-year leases for six 60,000-ton multipurpose heavy-lift vessels, with annual rent around CNY134m after delivery. Capacity growth and fixed-cost demand risk coexist.

US overnight summary

Indexes and macro
Indexes edged lower as long yields reached multi-year highs
The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq lost 0.26%, 0.17% and 0.08%. US 10-year and 30-year yields rose to 5.293% and 5.6206%, limiting valuation expansion.
Stocks and mapping
Meta and CarMax rose while FICO suffered major negative feedback
Meta gained 3.26% and CarMax 4.74%; FICO fell 26.66% and NVDA 0.76%. A/H mapping should focus on company events and regulatory sensitivity, not extrapolate QQQ's small gain.
Ranking availability
Industry and concept snapshots lag by one session
Latest attemptedAt=2026-09-29 10:17 CST does not cover the complete Sep 29 US session. Both groups are degraded to zero rows; stale tables and stock substitutes are excluded.

Premarket conclusion

Fact: Counter-cyclical and property policy gained Vanke price confirmation, A-share breadth and median improved, and the marketing rules and battery plan provide compliance and industrial leads.

View: On the final pre-holiday session, keep exposure light and require strong confirmation. Property focus stays on price-confirmed leaders; solid-state batteries and fintech need company filings and relative strength.

Uncertainty: Turnover is at a phase low, Hang Seng Tech fell 1.55%, and US long yields are at multi-year highs. RoboTechnik's broken IPO and Many Idea Cloud's suspension are direct narrative-vs-price/disclosure counter-evidence.

Key stock ideas

Vanke A
SZ.000002
Conditional watch

Fact and status: Property-support expectations drove a Sep 29 close of CNY4.08, up 9.97%, on about 802m shares. This is price-confirmed policy trading, not proof that fundamental risk is gone.

Confirmation: Retain relative strength versus property peers after the open with sustained volume and no new major debt or sales deterioration.

Risk and invalidation: Low-price volatility, sales and credit risk, and a post-holiday policy-expectation gap. Cancel the watch if a gap-up fades below the property group.

RoboTechnik
SZ.300757 / HK.03757
Avoid chasing

Fact and status: H shares were offered at HK$436 and closed their debut at HK$414.40, down 4.95%; the A shares closed at CNY529.00, down 0.25%. The silicon-photonics narrative lacks synchronized A/H confirmation.

Reassessment: H shares recover above the offer price while A shares outperform optical-communications/equipment peers with sustained volume.

Risk and invalidation: Broken IPO, valuation, equipment-cycle and expansion-execution risks. Negative price feedback cannot be packaged as a bullish call.

Many Idea Cloud
HK.06696
Avoid

Fact and status: Trading remains suspended and results are delayed, so no current tradable quote is available. Disclosure and resumption uncertainty dominate the business narrative.

Reassessment: Overdue results are filed, HKEX resumption guidance is satisfied, normal trading resumes, and audit/internal-control issues receive verifiable conclusions.

Risk and invalidation: Extended suspension, audit and governance uncertainty, and potential delisting. Avoid until resumption conditions are met.

Sector rotation board

Property chain

Policy support and Vanke's limit-up close align, but holiday liquidity is thin. Track leader follow-through rather than chase broad diffusion.

Solid-state batteries

The 2030 scale target is a medium-term roadmap. Near-term trades require production, yield and order evidence rather than theme extrapolation.

Fintech

Marketing rules take effect today, lifting compliance demand while also increasing platform remediation costs and operating constraints.

HK tech and IPOs

Hang Seng Tech was weak and RoboTechnik broke its offer price. Price feedback is the first counter-evidence for high-valued hard-tech names.

Logic chain

Counter-cyclical + property policy → Vanke limit-up confirms a short-term trade → track only leader follow-through before the holiday.
3,434 A-share advancers vs 1,945 decliners + Shanghai only +0.02% + low turnover → breadth beats index but momentum is limited → control chasing.
QQQ slightly higher + US 10-year at 5.293% + FICO plunge → extreme growth divergence → verify A/H tech at company level.
RoboTechnik breaks its H-share offer price + Many Idea Cloud suspended → listing/business narratives cannot replace price and disclosure → both remain avoids.

Risk radar

Holiday liquidity

Mainland turnover fell to the lowest since July 2025, raising holiday holding and post-holiday gap risk.

Long yields and oil

The US 10-year yield reached 5.293%; geopolitics and energy can still lift inflation and discount rates.

HK tech and IPOs

Hang Seng Tech fell 1.55% and RoboTechnik broke its offer price, showing unstable support for hot themes.
